qualification.explanation: 2026 is in progress. Thresholds scale with the busiest goalkeeper in the league (3495 minutes): qualified at 50% of that (1748 minutes) and provisional at 20% (699 minutes), subject to absolute floors of 270 and 90 minutes.

league.note: KeeperIQ is a minutes-weighted percentile within the qualified and provisional pool, so 50 is the median goalkeeper. A goalkeeper with exactly league-average adjusted impact (0.05 G+/96) scores 47.6 in this view, because the distribution is not symmetric.
